title: Bikewatching: Bluebikes Traffic Map
description:
Geospatial visualization of Boston/Cambridge bike traffic pairing a Mapbox base map with a D3 SVG overlay. Proportional station markers and a full-day time slider reveal how stations shift between departure and arrival hubs across commuting hours.
                        Mapbox GL JS · D3.js · geospatial visualization · temporal filtering

title: Early-Match Advantage in Professional League of Legends
description:
Predicts match winners from the first ten minutes of play using 144,780 records from the 2022 Oracle's Elixir dataset. Tuned logistic regression with engineered early-game features (KDA, gold per CS, combat intensity) reached 83.96% accuracy and 0.9061 ROC-AUC, with permutation testing confirming no side-based fairness gap.
                        Python · pandas · scikit-learn · Plotly · hypothesis testing · model fairness

title: Large-Scale Steam Review Sentiment Analysis
description:
Distributed NLP pipeline classifying review sentiment across 113M raw reviews (50+ GB), processed on the SDSC Expanse supercomputer after Parquet conversion. TF-IDF features and a tuned random forest on 36M cleaned reviews reached ~70% accuracy on a class-balanced task.
                        PySpark · Spark ML · Parquet · TF-IDF · distributed computing

title: NETCLIX: Interactive Recommendation Explainer
description:
Netflix-styled visualization that teaches how recommender systems work — walking users through ratings matrices, sparsity, user similarity, Jaccard overlap, and collaborative filtering via an interactive heatmap, Venn diagram, and guided tour.
                        JavaScript · D3.js · SVG · Venn.js · narrative visualization

title: Forecasting Nonprofit Donor Retention (Capstone)
description:
Operational ML pipeline scoring each Curebound donor's probability of lapsing, built on 221K+ Salesforce CRM transactions (2013–2026). Leakage-safe temporal design and a calibrated XGBoost model hit 0.754 AUPRC; targeting the top 1,000 riskiest donors captured ~79% precision and 1.26× lift over random outreach.
                        Python · SQL · XGBoost · Platt calibration · AUPRC · temporal validation

title: Customer Review Sentiment Analysis
description:
This project explores sentiment classification of product reviews 
                        using a combination of TF-IDF and Word2Vec embeddings integrated 
                        into a soft-voting ensemble of Logistic Regression and XGBoost models.

title: Data Visualization Dashboard with Tableau
description:
A dynamic Tableau dashboard created to visualize KPIs, price 
                        distributions, and consumer behavior trends across multiple retail 
                        datasets, providing executive-level insights at a glance.

title: Aircraft Sustainment Analytics
description:
End-to-end analytics pipeline for fleet maintenance: synthetic data generation feeds a validated SQLite warehouse, shared feature engineering, and a model predicting which open maintenance events are at risk of running past 48 hours, surfaced through a Streamlit app for planners.
                        Python · SQLite · scikit-learn · feature engineering · Streamlit
